page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.large is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB memory-per-core ratio. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache, alongside support for instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI for vector neural network instructions, and AES cryptography.

Benchmark evaluations place the performance of this instance in the lower tiers. In CPU-intensive tests, the stress-ng single-core score is 1305.19, while the multi-core score reaches 1737.28. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1156.0 and a multi-core score of 1379.0. Memory bandwidth benchmarks show a cached read speed of 96.8 GB/sec, which drops to 12.97 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 11.91 GB/sec for uncached large-block writes. These metrics indicate constrained processing and memory throughput under heavy workloads.

The ecs.c6e.large instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage solutions. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. Given its dedicated CPU allocation but modest hardware profile, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for entry-level compute tasks that do not require high memory density. It is suitable for lightweight workloads such as basic web serving, small-scale database operations, and simple utility tasks that benefit from dedicated CPU cores but do not demand high memory or storage throughput.
